svg.title: Industrial electrician — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as industrial electrician, wearing coveralls and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A switchgear panel has three separated supply terminals, a disconnect lever and a breaker module. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
